_note: Games whose Sony artwork is wrong (another game's cover, or a placeholder). tools/fetch_art.py won't use Sony artwork for these; tools/fetch_wiki.py fills them from Wikipedia instead.
_note_wiki: Games tools/fetch_wiki.py should not match to any Wikipedia article (its match was a different game).
_note_wiki_art: Games whose Wikipedia article is right but whose main image is another game's cover; the description is kept, the cover isn't.
